nm: TLDR Astro — Sun, Moon, Earth, Star

meta.source: Original vector paths drawn from the owner-provided four-symbol reference, October 12, 2026.
meta.motion: 2.8-second clockwise loop, 700 ms per icon. Each icon starts its 3 px lift as the previous icon finishes its bounce, including Earth to Sun at the loop boundary. No anticipation or idle interval. A -2 degree tilt, 5% width expansion on landing, and one 0.4 px rebound retain subtle elasticity. CSS preserves the 2 px stroke.
meta.easing: Minimum-jerk progress 6t^5-15t^4+10t^3, represented by four cubic Hermite sections per transition. Shared endpoint velocities remove speed jumps between sections; reversal velocity is zero. The same easing smooths brightness crossfades.
